scheme_name: Jharkhand State Scheduled Caste Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme
other_conditions: Must be enrolled in a recognized educational institution registered on the departmental scholarship portal
Must be pursuing a post‑matric course such as degree, diploma or certificate
Must not be receiving any other scholarship or financial assistance from the central or state government
Must adhere to the attendance system prescribed by the institution to qualify for the scholarship
If the student switches courses mid‑way, eligibility for the new course applies only if no scholarship was received for the previous course in the same academic year
benefits_summary: Provides tuition fees, academic allowance and maintenance fees (up to ₹1,00,000 per year) directly credited to the student’s Aadhaar‑linked bank account via Direct Benefit Transfer
